title: Man shot multiple times near corner store on Syracuse’s South Side
summary: A man was shot multiple times in the back early Sunday, August 2, 2026, on Syracuse's South Side near the 500 block of Oakwood Avenue. Syracuse Police responded to a ShotSpotter alert detecting multiple gunshots shortly after 1 a.m. This incident represents an ongoing public safety concern in the South Side neighborhood.
